caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a chest with three main sections. The chest is rendered in a reddish-brown wood color, with subtle variations in tone to suggest the grain and natural appearance of the wood. The upper section of the chest features a single, larger compartment with a keyhole at the center near the top, indicating it may be lockable. Below this, there are two horizontal drawers, each with two round brass-colored knobs centered on the drawer fronts. The chest stands on four legs, each with a decorative cut-out detail forming a bracket foot style. The perspective of the drawing shows the front and left side of the chest, with clear, defined lines and shading to emphasize the rectangular, boxy shape of the furniture. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or decorative elements present, focusing attention solely on the chest.
title: Shaker Blanket Chest
